decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX trommel builds on a well-established screening platform that is core to the firm, even though it no longer appears separately on the website and may have been folded into the standard range.
Mobile flail shredders fit the core mobile recycling portfolio, but their absence from the website since 2020 suggests reduced emphasis, so the risk is moderate.

The high-speed grinder line was only mentioned and has not been visible since 2020, and the related green-waste grinder was already withdrawn, so concentrating on the stronger slow-speed and screening lines makes sense.
This niche stationary electric fine shredder had low visibility from the start and has disappeared from the website, so its resources are better used in the established business.
Stationary pre-shredders support the firm's plant-based and international strategy, though their missing web presence since 2020 adds uncertainty.
